purpose: Unlit spherical albedo maps based on approved v4 art

prompts.prompt: Create a production-ready 2048x1024, 2:1 equirectangular ALBEDO TEXTURE MAP for a gas giant sphere in a stylized space game. The attached screenshot is ONLY the approved reference for painterly cloud style and color, not an output composition. Extract the planet's art language and invent a complete continuous 360-degree cloud surface, unwrapped into a full rectangular latitude-longitude map. Fill EVERY pixel edge-to-edge with cloud surface. NO circular planet, NO sphere shape, NO rim, NO atmosphere, NO background space, NO stars, NO ship, NO HUD, NO text, NO transparency. Absolutely NO baked lighting, cast shadows, terminator, sunlit hemisphere or vignette: flat even illumination across the whole map. Lighting and atmospheric shading will be applied by the engine. Use flowing horizontal zonal cloud belts with varied width, turbulence and several large oval vortices, gently curved brush-shaped islands of color and hand-painted stepped tone bands. Detail should wrap naturally over a sphere; horizontal left and right edges must match seamlessly, and the extreme top and bottom edges should be simple quiet color to avoid a polar seam. Keep contrast moderate and cloud features legible. Painterly celestial surface, not satellite photography, not a flat vector poster and not noisy marble. Color palette: deep emerald, forest green, medium green, muted olive and narrow chartreuse bands; avoid pale mint, luminous yellow or white
